    if not condition:

def normalized(value):
    return ' '.join((value or '').split())

    handle = locator.element_handle()
    require(handle is not None, 'target has no element handle')
    return bool(page.evaluate('(el) => document.activeElement === el', handle))


def active_is_focus_visible(page, locator):
    handle = locator.element_handle()
    require(handle is not None, 'focus target has no element handle')
    return bool(page.evaluate('(el) => document.activeElement === el && el.matches(\":focus-visible\")', handle))


def wait_cards_count(page, count):

    )
